{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I want my dark blessing. Just as you gave my father, Emperor Palpatine.|Trioculus to Kadann|<ref name="The Lost City of the Jedi">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
'''Dark blessings''' were [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] rituals that were bestowed upon such individuals as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Trioculus]] by the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]].

After finding the [[Glove of Darth Vader]] on [[Dac/Legends|Calamari]], Trioculus set out to the [[Scardia Station]] to receive the dark blessing from [[Kadann]], the [[Supreme Prophet]]. Trioculus knew that if he received the Dark blessing, he would convince skeptics such as [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Josef Grunger]] that he was the true heir to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] throne.
